subject: Request: HSM key recovery & Separation-of-Duties artifacts for SIG
messages:
From: Elena Park <security@northbridgehealth.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: HSM / KMS evidence request

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team at NorthBridge is progressing through the SIG questionnaire and we hit a few open items that need concrete evidence before we move forward with procurement. Can you provide the following artifacts?

- HSM attestation (vendor report or FIPS/HSM cert) covering the current tenant-facing HSM cluster
- KMS rotation logs showing key rotation events and who initiated them (last 3 months)
- Description of emergency key-recovery procedures and a recent DR test summary
- Separation-of-duties (SOD) mapping for HSM operator roles vs. PKI/recovery operators
- The BYOK handshake manifest and any HSM wrapping metadata (non-sensitive fields only)

We understand some items may be redacted; please indicate what can be produced as-is, what will be redacted, and an ETA for delivery. Our compliance window is early next week (we're working toward a 2028-07-05 deadline).

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park
Senior InfoSec Manager, NorthBridge Health
security@northbridgehealth.com

From: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <security@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: HSM / KMS evidence request

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Irene from our Infosec team and Monica from Customer Success to coordinate artifacts and the delivery timeline.

Irene — can you confirm which of the items below we can produce as downloadable artifacts vs. redacted summaries? Monica, I'll let you own delivery to the NorthBridge share once we have the bundle.

To confirm scope: HSM attestation (full PDF), rotation logs (CSV with operator ids), DR test summary (redacted timeline acceptable), SOD mapping (CSV), BYOK manifest (metadata only).

ETA: I think we can get an initial package by EOD Monday (2028-07-01) and a supplemental SOD operator mapping shortly after if needed. If any item requires legal review, flag it.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Elena Park <security@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: HSM / KMS evidence request

Hi Elena / Alex — thanks for the ping. Quick status and what we'll attach: 

1) HSM attestation: redwood_hsm_attestation_20280601.pdf (full vendor attestation; includes firmware baseline and FIPS module references).
2) KMS rotation events: kms_rotation_events_202805-202806.csv.gz (we will sanitize tenant identifiers; logs include timestamp, key_id, rotation_type, initiator_role).
3) BYOK manifest: byok_handshake_manifest_20280412.json (metadata only; no key material).
4) DR test summary: we can provide a redacted DR playbook excerpt and the test summary (dates redacted).

Note on SOD: the operator_sod_mapping file requires a brief internal review before publication because it includes role-to-person mappings. We can produce a role-level SOD CSV today and a person-level mapping under NDA or via a secure transfer. 

I will upload the role-level SOD mapping to the NorthBridge evidence folder and provide a link. If you need person-level mapping for audit, let us know a contact at NorthBridge and we'll work the access model.

--
Irene Choi
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <security@northbridgehealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: HSM / KMS evidence request

Irene — this looks good, thank you. Two follow-ups before we close our control set: 

- Please include the operator role mapping (role-level CSV is fine). If we require person-level mappings for the audit trail, we'll escalate with our legal/ procurement team and request an NDA.
- Can you include a small extract (1–2 rows) from the rotation CSV showing an example rotation event and the audit trail fields (timestamp, initiator_role, rotation_id)? A compressed CSV excerpt is fine.

If you can get those into the shared folder by EOD today (2028-07-01), we should be able to proceed.

Best — Elena

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
